relations.rationale: Practicing openings has no bearing on Xavi's height or shelf access.
Jude's eagerness to try a new variation has no bearing on when Ivo arrived.
Jude's eagerness to try a new opening variation could plausibly lead to a longer, unfinished game, but this is speculative and not a direct logical link.
The rating system being standard doesn't directly cause confusion, though it's the same system referenced, the claims describe separate facts without causal link from A to B.
The scoring system used for the match has no bearing on the advisor's brief visit to check attendance.
Xavi not driving the minibus has no bearing on his height helping him reach shelves.
Ivo's arrival time has no bearing on the advisor's attendance check.
Ivo arriving before Jude doesn't determine whether Tess arrived before Jude, as these are independent arrival orders.
The advisor walking in to check attendance is consistent with and supports the idea that the advisor also left scoresheets during that visit.
Xavi being taller than most younger members supports the claim that his height helps him reach the higher shelf.
Xavi's height relative to others has no bearing on whether games were finished by session's end.
Tess arriving before Jude has no direct bearing on whether games were unfinished by the end.
Unfinished games at the end of the session could motivate scheduling a follow-up meeting, supporting the idea of Nell's promise.
